rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for an aircraft, especially an ordinary plane or helicopter.

example.english: The aircraft is about to land.
example.jyutping: gaa3 fei1 gei1 zau6 faai3 gong3 lok6 laa3

rows.note: Use this more precise technical term when referring broadly to any vehicle designed to fly, including less ordinary types.

example.english: This type of aircraft can fly at high altitude for long periods.
example.traditional: 呢種飛行器可以喺高空長時間飛行。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 fei1 haang4 hei3 ho2 ji5 hai2 gou1 hung1 coeng4 si4 gaan3 fei1 hang4
